character: Skiing between Grindelwald and car-free Wengen beneath the Eiger, Mönch and Jungfrau, centred on Kleine Scheidegg and Männlichen; the Lauberhorn World Cup downhill is raced above Wengen (reference). The Eiger Express gondola links Grindelwald Terminal with the Eigergletscher station (reference).
